sources.citation: Liu, MacWhinney, Fromm & Lanzi (2023), Automation of Language Sample Analysis
sources.role: Published Batchalign system context; original adult clinical cohorts differ from our public child corpora
sources.status: Official 0.10.4 segmentation component rerun on our identical public paragraphs; not numerical reproduction of original article

sources.citation: Wagner et al. (2025), The Ohio Child Speech Corpus
sources.role: Published corpus and MLU analyses; common human CHAT references with audio
sources.status: 126-task combined benchmark includes 111 OCSC sections; first OCSC audio task preselected for MOSS pilot. Published age/robot analyses not reproduced

sources.citation: Steen et al. (2026), Introducing the NYU–Emerson Corpus
sources.role: Clinical child corpus with human CHAT references and video
sources.status: 15 transcript test sections, four test children; audio not evaluated this continuation

sources.citation: Pelfrey et al. (2024), Evaluating the accuracy of automated processing of child and adult language production in preschool classrooms
sources.access: Article limits data to IRB-approved study team members; do not imply a public direct-replication benchmark
sources.status: Context only, not a ranked cross-dataset comparison

sources.citation: Baese-Berk et al. (2021), Lexical Diversity, Lexical Sophistication, and Predictability for Speech in Multiple Listening Conditions
sources.role: Actual published TAALED result rows, not just aggregate reliability
sources.status: All 300 source TextGrids and first stereo audio downloaded through user-authorized access. 180 metadata-joined rows compared across 15 metrics; 60 vocoder rows ambiguous. Significant discrepancies/no exact token matches. Original cleaned input mapping and historical tool configuration still needed; not exact reproduction.

sources.role: Norms and human C-units for MLCU/TNW/NDW
sources.status: Not imported/evaluated; no TalkBank audio. MLCU splits contractions and excludes mazes, certain responses, interruptions and story enders; current profile cannot silently be equated to these norms
